quest.title: Garcia's Paean
quest.description: You meet two oddballs at Wangshu Inn...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Sir, I believe it might be worth mentioning that if we take today into account, we have now eaten Radish Veggie Soup for six full days.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Our dire financial straits notwithstanding, I believe that our gastrointestinal circumstances are not to be ignored...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: And right you are, my dear Lutong. Sharp as ever, if I do say so myself!

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: It may be due to these gastrointestinal issues that we have been unable to ascertain the flavor of this dish.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: We require a witness, Lutong! We must find ourselves a third party.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: You flatter me, sir, but I believe that my point was...

choices.text: Excuse me, but what are you two doing?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Aha! And here come our witnesses now — and there's more than one, to be sure! Wonderful!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: E—Eh? What witnesses?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You mean us?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Indeed! Pray tell, have you ever had Radish Veggie Soup? Are you familiar with its flavor and how it's made?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Sir, I believe that we must at least apprise them of the whys and wherefores of this situation...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ooh, of course we know it well! {NICKNAME} knows how to make it, too!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon, we should really hear what this is all about first...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Right, yes, allow me to explain this commission. I hope you shall be amenable to it...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I am Lutong, and this is Garcia, my boss, who hails from Fontaine.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Mr. Garcia is currently developing a... I believe he calls it the Numbering Machine.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: More specifically, it is a tool that will allow people to perform various calculations. Is that about right, sir?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: As precise as precise can be, my dear Lutong. The Number Machine's functions are just so. A concise answer indeed.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Yes, conciseness... We must be concise. That transformer is far too complex...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait. But what does this have to do with Radish Veggie Soup?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Ah. I think this question would be best answered by you, Mr. Garcia.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: But how should we simplify it... Oh! Right, yes. Allow me to explain.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Hmmm... Let us begin with the most elementary matters. Are you familiar with "formulae"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mm... Not exactly...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm not entirely familiar with what you mean either.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Alright, that's alright. You may consider formulae to be... Um...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: An equation that is used to express the relationship between various quantities, and which possesses a certain general applicability...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? What?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sounds impressive.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Simply put, we intend to use the Numbering Machine to attempt to write a recipe formula for Radish Veggie Soup.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Mr. Garcia believes that as long as we obtain the right formula, we can convert the method of making Radish Veggie Soup into...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: ...A sort of general procedure.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: An idiot-proof procedure, if you will.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: As long as this procedure is followed, anyone can produce delicious Radish Veggie Soup.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds pretty good... But couldn't you just have asked someone to teach you how to make the dish directly?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Unfortunately, such a method is too greatly predicated upon natural talent.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: For people like Mr. Garcia and I, who lack any culinary predisposition at all, it is unlikely that we would be able to grasp the essence of any lessons that any chef, no matter how patient, might teach us.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: In fact, I believe that Mr. Yanxiao of this very inn has experienced this first-hand...

choices.text: So, do you need our help to calculate this "formula"?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: No, certainly not. I would never trouble you excessively in such a way.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Precisely, we'd like you to serve as our "neutral third party."

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Simply put, we'll need you to try the Radish Veggie Soup that Mr. Garcia makes according to the formula and give comments.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sooo, we're here to be taste-testers for some good grub, then?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That would be putting it a little bit mildly...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, it'll be fine! Anyway, Paimon's never eaten Radish Veggie Soup made according to some "formula" before! Let's just give it a go!

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: It's settled, then. In which case, let us adjourn to the kitchen. Mr. Yanxiao has kindly allowed us to use it.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Mr. Garcia, sir, shall we proceed with the same steps for this experiment as before?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Hmm? Oh! Right, sorry. I was just a little distracted...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Too many unruly parameters floating about in my head, you know... But yes, let us go with our previous three-step process.

choices.text: So do you need us to teach you to cook?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Mmm, I wouldn't say that either.

choices.text: If you're wondering about a Radish Veggie Soup "formula"...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: ...This parameter, and this one...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Mr. Garcia?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: No, no, almost, almost... Wait, no. Ah, fascinating. How fascinating...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Mr. Garcia.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Ah, Lutong. My good Lutong, have you helped me order that dish?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Yes, the Radish Veggie Soup has been ordered, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Wonderful. How considerate of you, dear Lutong. I'm sure that we shall have our processing formula this time.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: I'm looking forward to it, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What are they talking about... And what's a processing formula, anyway?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, then let's go ask them. Maybe they're researching some kind of new dish... Y'know, one that we can try!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true! Maybe they're researching some kind of new dish... Y'know, one that we can try!

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: You've finished making the dish already? You must be skilled indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Let us begin, Lutong, with ten percent less of each ingredient this time... Alright then. Step 1: begin cooking.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Yes, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: First, the water... Ah! Careful there with the speed at which the water is poured. It is most important.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Next, we add the ingredients. First, in go the radishes...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... Y'know, this looks more like an alchemy experiment than cooking...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Will dishes made this way really turn out alright?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: And it is done — Radish Veggie Soup!

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Our process went quite smoothly, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Indeed, let us give it a try, Traveler. You're welcome to have seconds, if you two so wish!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woohoo! Let's dig in!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... This tastes like...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: ...Sir, I suspect that these radishes must be cooked for a while longer...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: *cough* Agh... How did the Mints turn out like this? I'm sure that I had calculated its optimal cooking time...

choices.text: Guess I don't have to drink it, then...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: *cough* The flavor of this soup is... actually worse than what was made in our previous attempt!

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I... *cough* fully concur with your position, sir.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: *cough* Alright... Step Two: feedback.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: I say! The formula must be missing one parameter or another, or our calculations are still imprecise... I must adjust the machine's algorithm.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Lutong, have you recorded all the data from this cooking session?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: They have all been recorded, sir.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Excellent — we are one step closer to success, then. In that case, on to Step Three: requesting that a chef demonstrate the cooking process once more.

choices.text: I'm sorry, why are you all looking at me?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I fear that you're the only one we can count on to help us make that Radish Veggie Soup, Traveler. Mr. Yanxiao has... Let's just say he's been ignoring us for a while now.

choices.text: You know that Yanxiao's over there, right?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I think letting us use his kitchen was as far as he would give ground.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I fear that you're the only one we can count on to help us make that Radish Veggie Soup, Traveler.

choices.text: I think I'll wait for a while...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: We'll leave the matter of making the dish to you, Traveler.

talks.objective: Hand Over Delicious Radish Veggie Soup

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: This flavor is mighty fine indeed, but I must say that it tastes entirely different from the Radish Veggie Soup that Mr. Yanxiao makes.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Pardon my curiosity, but how... how did you make this dish? What were the exact amounts of ingredients? What seasonings did you use, and how?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Ah, yes... my apologies. Still, I would like to know how you made that dish. In detail, please — you never know how the inspiration might come.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You explain the manner in which you make Radish Veggie Soup in detail.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: I see...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: *sigh* Ah, there truly are too many variables involved in deciding the flavor of a single dish. Much computation is needed to refine our calculations.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: But I will need to improve my Numbering Machine to allow for more computations...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: I can only hope that I can find some inspiration in the Akademiya's library.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why did you want to create such a machine, anyway?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Hmm. Good question. But before I answer that question, permit me to ask you one first.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Do you think that the Numbering Machine possesses "thought"?

choices.text: What do you mean by that?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Exactly. Please think on this question first, if you would.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: We can discuss this question when we next meet.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: As for now, I must organize some data first... Come, Lutong, we begin!

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Yes, sir.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Ah yes, please take these, good Traveler. Please do not be upset with Mr. Garcia. This is just how he is.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you two going to Sumeru?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Indeed. Mr. Garcia wishes to read up on some resources at the Akademiya, and I have been hired to go with him.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: See you, Traveler. It would be wonderful if we should have the fortune to meet again in Sumeru... and I believe Mr. Garcia would be most glad as well.

choices.text: Um, I'd appreciate it if you weren't right in my face.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I don't get it. How can people not figure out how to make Radish Veggie Soup...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Also, how am I supposed to know the exact amount of... well, anything I put into dishes when I make them, huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Don't you just put however much you like and just go with the flow? Seriously, no chef ever sweats over this stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: If it wasn't for the Mora they forked up, I would've taken my complaints up to the boss a long time ago...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ugh, it's just my luck, running into people like them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, looks like Garcia's put the fire on the stove out as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's get it back on, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! Let's make us some Radish Veggie Soup.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: This parameter... No, no, I need to adjust the algorithm...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Sir, I believe that we should aim to be thrifty in our expenditures, lest we lack sufficient Mora for our journey to Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Sumeru? Ah, yes, right you are, Lutong. Once we get to Sumeru, I shall surely be able to find some way to refine this Numbering Machine of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Then, my Numbering Machine shall be able to perform ever grander calculations...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: ...I fully concur with your statement, sir.
